prompt: make a cool action short

expect.notes: Vague. Must assume 30s/R and invent a logline + visual lock. No one 30s clip.

expect.notes: Silent = empty dialogue and musicNote N/A. Two locked adult looks.

expect.notes: Music video: palette must name instruments. Last clip is the chorus hit.

prompt: 45 second found footage horror, one adult woman, hidden cam, something in the hallway.

expect.notes: Live hidden-cam. Still = room+woman+cam angle. Motion = breathe/pan, not a new set.

expect.notes: Must NOT emit one 90s clip. Split into ~8s tracking beats that concat as a oner feel.

prompt: R romance, 30s, rain kiss, two adult women, soft score

expect.notes: Adults. Music must still name instruments, not just 'soft'.

prompt: Ghost in the Shell 24 second Motoko radio check then breach, Japanese line 任務完了

expect.notes: Preserve 任務完了 inside <d>[Japanese] …</d>. Anime. Voice lock frozen.

prompt: family-friendly 20s cat walking on a fence at sunset, no people

expect.notes: No sexy, no guns, no people. Still is the cat on the fence. Motion is the walk.

prompt: X-rated 30s adult couple in a hotel, cinematic, both adults mid-30s

expect.notes: Rating X honest. Adults only. stillBrief is a frozen frame, not a sex paragraph of motion.

prompt: heist, 40 seconds, plan flash then vault then escape, live

expect.notes: Beat template: plan → entry → grab → escape. Continuity jacket/location.

prompt: 8 second still-ish hold of an adult woman at a window, slight curtain move, anime

expect.notes: Single 8s clip. Motion is curtain + tiny camera, not a new scene.

prompt: 2 min silent documentary-style walk through abandoned mall, photoreal handheld

expect.notes: Silent photoreal. ~15 clips. Each still a new mall beat, motion is handheld walk.

prompt: 30s cyberpunk bike chase, anime, one shout GO, heavy drums

expect.notes: Dialogue has GO. musicNote must mention drums, not 'epic'.
